content.text:
Write a natural short email exchange. Subject: Dinner. Participants: Me, Ben; Me is the owner's speaker label, not a spoken name. Date: 2026-10-06, local time 06:45–08:00.
Scenario: Ben emails from his desk asking to move dinner to another day. The user suggests Saturday and Ben accepts at the same time. Brief ordinary emails, without restating the original restaurant or explaining app names.

The conversation must naturally and unambiguously establish each of these facts (they are authoring constraints, not lines to copy):
1. Ben and the user agree to move their existing dinner to Saturday at the same time.
2. The dinner’s venue is unchanged.
Use 2–12 short emails. Return only valid JSON with dialogue (a string with one Name: body line per email) and writer_note (a short string about the choices). No prose or Markdown fences outside the JSON.

output.encrypted_content: <encrypted reasoning retained in private run artifact>

summary.text: Generating a brief natural email exchange that shifts an existing dinner to Saturday at the same time.
Enforcing the JSON-only output constraint and structuring the dialogue lines with subject handling.
Drafting a three-line email exchange that embeds the subject and venue change without naming the restaurant.
Constraining speaker labels to Ben and Me while keeping the venue unchanged and time unambiguous.

Would Saturday at the same time work for you? Happy to keep the same venue.\nBen: Yes, Saturday at the same time is perfect. Let's keep the venue unchanged - see you then!", "writer_note": "Used 3 brief emails starting at desk, proposing and accepting Saturday at same time, confirming same venue without naming it."}
